insight: Incubated inside Every, the AI media-and-software studio — six months in private beta managing email for 2,500 users before launch.
name: Cora
tagline: AI email chief of staff — screens your Gmail, drafts replies, briefs you twice a day.
description: An AI email assistant that screens your inbox so only messages needing your response get through, drafts replies in your voice straight into your drafts folder, and summarizes everything else in a twice-daily brief. You can chat with it like a chief of staff — giving standing instructions for how kinds of email should be handled. Works with Gmail and Google Workspace accounts.

modelSupport.notes: Processes email using models from Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI.

edge: Replaces inbox-checking with a twice-daily brief instead of bolting a new client onto email — you keep Gmail, Cora does the triage.
pros: Drafts appear in your own voice
